bāhya mfn. [S. bāhya], being outside; from outside, foreign; the name of a people; ~e, adv., outside; Abh 1153 (bahiddhā bāhirā bāhye); Ja I 421,23* (~ā pi suhannena rājānam abhirādhayi; 421,25´ : ~ā ti bahijanapade jātā saṃvaḍḍhā itthī); Mp I 279,.6 (bāhiyaraṭṭhe pana jātattā Bāhiyo ti ’ssa nāmaṃ ahosi) ≠ Ud-a 78,.11; Th-a II 113,.21 (eko Gandhārarājakule eko °-raṭṭhe); — see also bāhika.

cakkhu
n. Spk II 354,.7 (~un ti dve ~ūni, ñāṇacakkhuṃ c’ eva maṃsacakkhuṃ ca); — 3. the eye of the world (as the means of man’s seeing); power of seeing, vision; (perhaps: light;) Vin II 284,.17 (atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto atikhippaṃ ~uṃ loke antarahitan ti) = D II 158,.2; A I 22,.29 (ekapuggalassa bhikkhave pātubhāvā mahato ~ussa pātubhāvo hoti mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti mahato obhāsassa pātubhāvo hoti …; Mp I 117,.10 : katamassa ~ussā ti paññācakkhussa); Sn 599 (~uṃ loke samuppannaṃ mayaṃ pucchāma Gotamaṃ;
